purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, visibility) at NYC-area airports, intended to feed flight delay and operations analyses that join on airport and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to combine with flight records at the matching airport and hour; consumers must handle nulls explicitly in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure rather than assuming zero or average values.
limitations: wind_gust is missing in 74.6% of rows (9702 of 13014) and should not be treated as reliably present; pressure is missing in 11.5% of rows (1496 of 13014) and wind_dir in 1.7% (219 of 13014); wind_speed is missing in 2 rows. No duplicate rows were found in bronze (duplicate_row_rate 0.0), so no dedupe logic was applied.
